entries.title: Answer a card over a full-screen game without leaving it
entries.body: On a Mac, turn on Show cards over other apps in Settings › Keyboard, then press Control+Shift+O, or a key you choose, in any app, even a full-screen game. The card waiting for you, the one your last notification was about first, opens at the edge of the screen and takes your keys while the game stays in front. Answer it, press the key again or Escape, or click the game, and your keys go straight back to the game; anything you typed and did not send is kept. Settings refuses a key macOS uses itself, such as a screenshot key; when two apps use one key, only the one that set it last hears it.

picture.alt: Settings, Keyboard, with Show cards over other apps turned on and its key, Control Shift O, beside Change key

entries.noDocsSite: The Keyboard page, which a script writes from the site's own words, gains a section on it, and no hand-written page covers keys set in Settings › Keyboard.
